question: Find observable transaction preparation rather than strategic fit.
scope: Six targeted queries across transaction disclosures, governance/compensation, ownership and partnerships; selective primary-source reads and annual-report keyword comparison. No personal travel tracking.

findings.finding: Annual-report excerpts concerning ownership concentration/change in control, Nasdaq issuance exemptions/change of control and Modig/Takeda history were the same in 2024 and 2025.
findings.limit: Targeted keyword comparison, not a full contract/exhibit redline. Does not establish absence of other changes.

findings.finding: Interim MD&A identifies Morgan Stanley and Leerink as May2026 offering underwriters; no basis to relabel as M&A advisers. Net proceeds USD124.3m; bank fees USD7.9m.
findings.limit: Does not exclude other undisclosed mandates.

findings.finding: No current named bid, strategic review, Takeda stake or disclosed bilateral acquisition process found.
findings.limit: Search-screen result, not comprehensive ownership audit or proof of no discussions. Secondary ownership pages not treated as verified evidence.

ranked_next_sources.source: New compensation/severance and retention agreement exhibits compared with historical versions
ranked_next_sources.signal: Transaction-contingent bonus or unusual coordinated change; ordinary annual refresh is competing explanation.

ranked_next_sources.source: Disclosed special committee, strategic-review mandate, advisory engagement or bidder stake/rights
ranked_next_sources.signal: Direct transaction preparation or buyer-specific optionality; distinguish financing and passive holdings.

ranked_next_sources.source: Public merger background filings for completed HAE deals
ranked_next_sources.signal: Reveals what contemporaneous signals were actually visible and bidder motives; anonymous bidders cannot be assigned to Takeda.

ranked_next_sources.source: Corporate licensing, patent assignments and regional-rights announcements
ranked_next_sources.signal: Buyer-specific contractual link; partnership may substitute for acquisition.

ranked_next_sources.source: Archived public commercial hiring and corporate spending disclosures
ranked_next_sources.signal: Abrupt coordinated change may justify investigation; trial timing, outsourcing and financing are alternative explanations.

decision: No probability increase or valuation change based on this screen. Preserve strategic-fit thesis separately. Stop before expensive archives or weak-proxy collection.
